title: Occident institutional review, Volumes I–X
scope: Institution-focused screening of all ten available linked volume indexes (April 1843–March 1853), followed by selected institutional passages and news notices. This is not a word-by-word review of every article, or coverage of the complete 1843–1868 run.
method: Screened all 1,955 article-link labels in ten volume indexes.
Selected 212 institution-related index entries by title, and additional News Items and election pages where headings can conceal local reports.
Screened 249 distinct source pages. Passage-linked means at least one specific passage supports a record; it does not mean every claim in that article has been extracted.

Screened-no-record-linked means no claim was added from that page in this pass. These pages include overseas reports, essays, proposals and unresolved identities; the status is not a finding that the page contains no institutions.

Institution dates and publication years are separate. A documentary year establishes evidence of activity or a reported historical event, not a continuous operational lifespan. Locality centers are not institution street addresses.

followUp.issue: Eight institutional index entries lack a linked transcription
followUp.detail: Retain as index-only leads; a title alone does not establish dates or an operating institution.
The 1850 officers resemble the older Mutual Assistance and Visitation society. Confirm the alias before merging records.
Do not equate the unnamed 1848 Gemilut Hassadim notice with Bikkur Cholim or Love and Benevolence without stronger evidence.
The second unnamed society in the 1852 almanac extract may relate to Eureka, but the identification remains unresolved.
Proposed colleges, dispensaries and school mergers remain research leads. Overseas reports have not been added to the current US institution dataset.
Some April 1852 files print Vol. IX although the archive files them under Volume X. Preserve the archive path and issue date; do not silently repair the source.
Only the ten volume indexes linked on this archive were available in the imported catalogue. Volumes after March 1853 have not been reviewed.
